info.cls_ename: College of Information and Electrical Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程是電路學(一)的延伸。主要內容由直流電路分析上，擴展到交流電路的分析。其中包括了弦波響應暫/穩態的分析、功率的計算、雙埠網路等。另外，也介紹頻率響應在電路分析方面的應用等。本課程銜接電子學等相關課程。
description.describe_eh: This course is an extension of Electric Circuits (1). It mainly focuses on the analysis of AC circuits. The content of this course covers the following topics: the sinusoidal transient and steady-state responses, power analysis, frequency response, and two-port networks. This course lays the foundation of Electronics.

targets.describe_ch: 能理解並解釋各種交流電路定義及分析方法，同時可區別他們的同異。
能應用電路定理與分析方法計算電路內各個元件的參數。

textBooks.tpb_book: C. Alexander and M. Sadiku, Fundamentals of Electric Circuits, Seventh Edition, International Student Edition, McGraw-Hill Education, 2021.
textBooks.tpb_book_en: C. Alexander and M. Sadiku, Fundamentals of Electric Circuits, Seventh Edition, International Student Edition, McGraw-Hill Education, 2021.

iSoftwares.soft_memo:
版本：MATLAB 2025a
功能：MATLAB 是一種商業數學軟體。主要用於數值分析、數值計算、工程與繪圖、控制系統的設計與模擬、數位影像處理、數學訊號處理和財務與金融等領域。
iSoftwares.soft_memo_en:
Version: MATLAB 2025a
Function: MATLAB is a commercial mathematics software. It is mainly used in the fields of numerical analysis, numerical calculation, engineering and drawing, design and simulation of control systems, digital image processing, mathematical signal processing, and finance.

iSoftwares.soft_memo:
版本：NI Multisim 14.1
功能：Multisim™ 教學​版​是​電路​教學​應用軟體，​適用於​類比、​數位​與​電子​電力​的​課程​與​實驗。​它​可​以運用​視覺​化​方式​呈現​電路，​並​透過​模擬​儀器、​進​階​分析​與​上千​款​互動​式​元件​來​強化​理論​學習。
iSoftwares.soft_memo_en:
Version: NI Multisim 14.1
Function: Multisim™ Teaching Edition is a circuit teaching application software suitable for analog, digital and electronic power courses and experiments. It presents circuits visually and enhances theoretical learning with analog instruments, advanced analysis, and thousands of interactive components.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
一、請準時上下課，請勿遲到、早退、曠課。 
二、請假者，請按照逢甲大學請假規定請假。
三、上課時請專心聽講。
四、有問題者，可以隨時舉手發問。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
1. Please come to and from get out of class on time. Please do not be late, leave early, or be absent from class.
2. If you are requesting leave, please apply for leave in accordance with Feng Chia University’s leave regulations.
3. Please pay attention during class.
4. If you have any questions, you can raise your hand and ask at any time.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
一、請養成課後複習的好習慣。
二、若有任何問題，可以在請益時間到我的辦公室請益。
三、請善用資訊電機學院安排的課後輔導時間。
四、上課的投影片屬於教科書之延伸，受到智慧財產權法律的保障，所以不開放給各位同學下載。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
1. Please develop a good habit of reviewing after class.
2. If you have any questions, you can come to my office during consultation hours.
3. Please make good use of the after-school tutoring time arranged by the College of Information and Electrical Engineering.
4. The slides used in class are an extension of the textbook and are protected by intellectual property laws, so they are not available for download by students.

2. Those who cheat in the exam will have their scores calculated as zero points.
